ideas.title: Shortcut list
ideas.notes: Collect the shortcuts used in the app and show them on "?".
ideas.prompt: Find every keyboard shortcut in src/, group them by page, and draft a "?" overlay that lists them.

ideas.title: Retry budget
ideas.notes: A customer with a broken endpoint should not use up the whole queue. Cap the retries per hour.
ideas.prompt: Sketch a retry budget per customer: how to count, where to store it, what happens when it runs out.
